headline: Gold and silver steady today after a sharp fall over the past month
summary: Gold 24K is unchanged at ₹12,508 per gram today, and silver is unchanged at ₹1,75,000 per kg, so there is no move to report from yesterday. Over the last 7 days gold has dropped about 9% (24K down ₹1,254 per gram) and silver about 10%, and across the 28 days of data gold is down about 12% and silver about 20%. The likely drivers are a softer international price, with spot gold near $3,539 an ounce and the rupee at about ₹92.87 to the dollar, along with easing festive and wedding buying demand; these are possibilities, not confirmed causes.
outlook: Prices have fallen a lot recently but did not move today, so there is no need to rush; buyers planning a purchase may prefer to compare rates across jewellers and check making charges and GST before deciding.
